items.text: Timothy E. Rueckert is a former Northfield Township highway commissioner. He worked in law enforcement for the Illinois Secretary of State, Gaming Board, and Department of Revenue, and earned a bachelor’s degree in accounting and finance. His campaign says that as highway commissioner, he worked on flood-control projects with the MWRD at Citation Lake, Northbrook West, and the Central Road Drainage District, and expanded the township’s recycling program.

items.text: His campaign says he would push for practical drainage projects, infrastructure upgrades, and a grant program to replace or reline existing public sanitary sewer lines. He also calls for competitive contracting, performance measures, and livestreaming board meetings.
